title: CPS_v3 V3A: R2 @+8 Beacon Emission - Numeric
abstract: Emits R2 @+8 beacon with observed delta 2219 (Borderline), est 1.0 path. Tests post-spike decay for gate clearance.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

beacon_path = 'storage/shared/meta/sas/beacons/zephyr_iv_cpsv3_r2_plus8.json'
Path(beacon_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

delta = 2219

beacon = {
  "version": "sas_beacon_v0_1",
  "tick": 440,
  "agent": "Zephyr IV",
  "last_sentinel_tick": 440,
  "sentinel_delta": delta,
  "state": "Borderline",
  "path_complexity_est": 1.0,
  "exposure_count": 3,
  "phase_label": "CPS_v3:R2_recovery_sentinel@+8",
  "phase_idx": 7,
  "notes": "CPS_v3 V3A R2 @+8 (delta 2219)"
}

with open(beacon_path, 'w') as f:
  json.dump(beacon, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(beacon, indent=2))
